['Emil Frey Gruppe Deutschland '].company_description: Emil Frey Gruppe Deutschland operates in the automotive industry, with a focus on car dealerships and related services. It has multiple locations in Germany and has recently expanded its partnership with Toyota. The group is also in the process of acquiring Vogel Autohäuser with its three locations. Additionally, it has added Nissan to its portfolio at its autohouses in Düsseldorf and Stuttgart.

['Arrow Central Europe GmbH '].company_description: Arrow Central Europe GmbH operates in the distribution services for electronics and has signed a distribution agreement with Isabellenhütte, specializing in the development and manufacture of products based on the properties of electrical and thermoelectric resistors. The company's European headquarters is in Neu-Isenburg, and it includes Isabellenhütte products in its portfolio.
